papers.headline: Little Red Dots from Primordial Vacuum Bubbles
papers.summary: Quantum tunneling transverse to the inflaton trajectory can produce 10⁶–10⁸M☉ primordial black holes at the abundance of JWST's little red dots, without the enhanced curvature perturbations excluded by limits on CMB spectral distortions.
papers.title: Little Red Dots from Primordial Vacuum Bubbles

papers.headline: Every galaxy is a radio source: a stellar-mass dependent minimum 150 MHz luminosity identified in the LoTSS Deep Fields
papers.summary: The second data release of the LOFAR Two-metre Sky Survey (LoTSS) Deep Fields includes the deepest wide-field 150 MHz mosaics in existence, covering the ELAIS-N1 field.
papers.title: Every galaxy is a radio source: a stellar-mass dependent minimum 150 MHz luminosity identified in the LoTSS Deep Fields

papers.headline: Demographic inference in exoplanet chemistry is shaped by retrieval assumptions
papers.summary: Understanding the chemical diversity of exoplanet atmospheres is crucial for linking atmospheric composition to planetary formation history.
papers.title: Demographic inference in exoplanet chemistry is shaped by retrieval assumptions
